..//: release-type is "simple", not "rust": the rust strategy's CargoToml updater requires a [package] version, and this repo's root Cargo.toml is a virtual workspace manifest ([workspace]/[workspace.package], no [package] section at all). A dry run against the real repo failed on every run with: Error: value at path package.version is not tagged (release-please/build/src/updaters/rust/cargo-toml.js). The workspace version is instead the first extra-files entry below, a toml jsonpath into [workspace.package].version. Do not switch this back to "rust" without first fixing that upstream requirement.

extra-files.//: "generic", not "yaml", for the same reason release-type is not "rust". The yaml updater does not patch the line the jsonpath names, it re-emits the whole document from its parse tree: the 0.2.0 release deleted all 71 comment lines in ios/project.yml, renamed the &appInfo anchor to &ref_0 and requoted every scalar. The marked line reads MARKETING_VERSION: "x.y.z" # x-release-please-version, and generic replaces the version on that line alone.
